cassian-andor--lay-low.text:
While this unit is defending, the attacker gets –2/–0.
If an enemy card ability would deal damage to this unit, prevent 2 of that damage.
cassian-andor--lay-low.officialRules:
Enemy card abilities include any ability controlled by an enemy on a unit, upgrade, or event. Combat damage is not a card ability.
If Cassian has a Shield attached to him, you can choose in what order to resolve the damage prevention effects.

exiled-from-the-force.text:
Attached unit loses the Force trait and all abilities except for Grit.
Attached unit gains Grit.
exiled-from-the-force.rules: The attached unit can't gain abilities other than Grit.

sly-moore--witness-to-power.text:
When Played: For this phase, each enemy unit gets –2/–0 while it's attacking a base.
Plot (When you deploy a leader, you may play this card from your resources, paying its cost. Replace it with the top card of your deck.)
sly-moore--witness-to-power.rules: (ERRATA) When Played: For this phase, while a base is being attacked by an enemy unit, the attacker gets -2/-0.

vigil--securing-the-future.text:
If damage would be dealt to another friendly unit, prevent 1 of that damage.
If damage would be dealt to this unit by another card, deal that much damage plus 1 instead.
Plot
vigil--securing-the-future.rules:
If the other friendly unit has a Shield attached, you can choose in what order to resolve the prevention effects.
Vigil's ability applies to a single instance of damage once; after increasing or decreasing the total damage dealt by 1, Vigil's ability does not resolve again.

umbaran-mobile-cannon.text: The first time this unit would take damage each phase, prevent that damage.
